blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust in the K-12 & School Systems context — regulation-first design, a fixed delivery rhythm, and outcomes your board can audit.

School systems serve every child under public scrutiny: learning analytics, special-education compliance, safeguarding and parental communication. Technology must be privacy-strict (minors), accessibility-complete and teacher-time-respecting.

items: Assessment, attendance and wellbeing data siloed; interventions late.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Cloud Security & Posture Management, AI Security & Model Protection, Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Learning analytics, Safeguarding case management, Special-ed compliance) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — FERPA/GDPR-K among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Evidence once, audit anywhere: compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
Never trust, always verify: zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.
Detection that keeps pace: intelligence-driven SOC with the boring parts (tuning, coverage) done properly.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Education & Research level this capability reads as: segmentation and recovery drills for academic continuity (restart time proven in exercises). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The rhythm is fixed on purpose: progress becomes visible from week one, not after the first steering meeting. The first two weeks lock the baseline: your team and ours measure the current metric together and sign it. Weeks 3–8 carry the pilot on bounded scope — a single decision path, workflow, plant or portfolio — and a control owner on your side owns the evidence. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement, and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Missing a gate produces a documented decision to stop or redirect — never a silent extension.
